tickerText: [TENNIS] China Open final Tuesday in Beijing: Novak Djokovic (33-0 in Beijing) meets Alex de Minaur after Daniil Medvedev was defaulted when a ball struck a spectator with Djokovic leading 7-5, 5-3; de Minaur advanced when Hubert Hurkacz retired • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open qualifying starts Oct. 6 at O West as world No.1s Hania El Hammamy and Mostafa Asal open their Diamond title defenses ahead of the Pyramids glass court • [BADMINTON] CLASH OF CLANS Arctic Open 2026 opens in Vantaa—Jason Gunawan faces Christo Popov in round one; Lee Zii Jia begins qualifying; Shi Yuqi withdrew • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup day two in Northbrook: senior open and pro qualifying at the tour's debut 1,500-point indoor Cup at Life Time North Shore • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash last-32 day in Beijing: Sun Yingsha beat Yeh Yi-Tian 3-1; Tomokazu Harimoto rallied from 0-2 past Jonathan Groth; Truls Moregard edged Chan Baldwin 20-18 in the fifth

newsItems.title: Djokovic Into Beijing Final On Default
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic reached the China Open final at 33-0 in Beijing after Daniil Medvedev was defaulted for a ball that hit a spectator; he faces Alex de Minaur on Tuesday.

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Pro Qualifying Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup's second day in Northbrook features senior open play and pro qualifying at the PPA Tour's new 1,500-point indoor stop.

newsItems.title: Harimoto Escapes, Sun Rolls In Beijing
newsItems.excerpt: WTT China Smash round-of-32 action saw Sun Yingsha beat Yeh Yi-Tian 3-1 and Tomokazu Harimoto come back from two games down to defeat Jonathan Groth.

newsItems.title: Arctic Open Kicks Off In Vantaa
newsItems.excerpt: The BWF Arctic Open Super 500 began in Finland with Jason Gunawan drawing world No.2 Christo Popov in men's singles while Shi Yuqi withdrew from the field.
